text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to an uninhabited island with 
Matikane Fukukitaru to take a breather. As 
we were about to board the boat back...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the last train just left! Wait, not 
the last train, the last boat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The last boat won't depart for a little 
while yet. At least, that's what Matikane 
Fukukitaru told me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing something suspicious, pressing 
further leads to...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
N-No, this is, um... "You fell for it!" 
Isn't it... um...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I deliberately told you the 
wrong time."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I had my reasons, but I really wanted to 
stay on this island just the two of us 
today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Actually, late tonight, a meteor shower is 
scheduled to be visible on this island...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to watch it together with 
Trainer and make a wish! I really, truly 
did!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Because I might never get another chance 
like this. I just really wanted to make 
memories together. So...
choice_data_list: If only you'd told me from the start...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Because~ it'd be such a shock if you 
rejected me~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If they told me, 'I'd rather die than do 
that~!', I'd have no choice but to 
prostrate myself on the sandy beach!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no way they'd say that. —The two 
of us decided to watch the meteor shower 
together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it's almost time. My expectations are 
super-duper-duper high!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The power of a meteor shower is truly 
incredible. Seeing the stars streak by in 
an instant makes me feel as though I could 
run just like that too...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here it comes, here it comes, here it 
is! Look, whoosh-whoosh-whooshing in! 
That's our Matikanefukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's so beautiful, so moving. Ah, I could 
gaze at it forever...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Feels like I'm forgetting 
something. What are you supposed to do 
while watching shooting stars again?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, absolutely! We can make all the 
wishes we want, completely unrestricted! 
I'm going all out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"May I seize victory together with you, 
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As many, many, maaaany wishes as there are 
shooting stars! Please grant them all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we prayed heartily. So that we 
could claim countless victories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we won, we won, we won again!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu~, this must also be a blessing from 
the meteor shower.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I want to go to that deserted island 
again! Next time, definitely when our ship 
sinks and we get washed ashore together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, the story had turned 
into something out of a survival movie. 
Even so, the meteor shower had an 
incredible effect.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Was that so? But still, this is a great 
chance for us to race each other.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right! Wait up, Shooting Star! Let's 
race to see who can circle the Earth 
first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru runs freely in all 
directions. Across the beach, through the 
shallows, and over the sea.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gah! *gargle* *sputter*! Tlainel... shelp 
mee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I almost drowned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Won and won, I've won yet again! How 
about that? Speed like a shooting star, 
wouldn't you say!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It feels like that chase imbued me with 
the power of a shooting star! Ahh, what 
miraculous divine favor~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Nearly drowning seems to have 
strengthened my lung capacity.
